summary: Preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute an obfuscated sibling payload
details: @or-sdk/content-request@0.2.6 ships a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub oven-sh releases into a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727 KB heavily obfuscated blob using string-array rotation (`WV8StW` shift/push loop), a multi-thousand-entry constant table (`n7gIxM`), and a custom base-N decoder (`hc1jfK9`) with an inline substitution alphabet — its runtime behavior is not readable from the shipped source. The package's advertised purpose is a content-request HTTP SDK, which has no need for a second JavaScript runtime or an opaque payload. The alternate-runtime hop specifically avoids Node-based static analysis: on `npm install`, arbitrary attacker-defined code executes on the installer's host under whatever behavior the obfuscated blob implements.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
